name: news-analytics-platform
description: News Analytics Platform with dual deployment support

scripts.dev: echo 'Use: docker compose up OR run backend and frontend separately'
scripts.build:backend: echo 'Backend does not require build step'
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

scripts.vercel:build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
